details.question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires total en 2024 ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    2024 AS Annee_Filtre, 
    SUM(CA_TND) AS Chiffre_Affaires_Total
FROM FACT_Vente
WHERE YEAR(Date_Facture) = 2024;

details.question: Combien de factures distinctes avons-nous émises en 2023 ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    2023 AS Annee_Filtre, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT Num_Facture) AS Nb_Factures_Distinctes
FROM FACT_Vente
WHERE YEAR(Date_Facture) = 2023;

details.question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires par mois pour l'année 2024 ?
details.generated_sql:
WITH Mois AS (
    SELECT 1 AS M UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 
    UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 
    UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12
)
SELECT 
    2024 AS Annee_Filtre,
    m.M AS Mois, 
    ISNULL(SUM(v.CA_TND), 0) AS Total_CA_TND
FROM Mois m
LEFT JOIN FACT_Vente v ON MONTH(v.Date_Facture) = m.M AND YEAR(v.Date_Facture) = 2024
GROUP BY m.M 
ORDER BY m.M;

details.question: Combien de commandes clients avons-nous eu chaque mois en 2024 ?
details.generated_sql:
WITH Mois AS (
    SELECT 1 AS M UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 
    UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 
    UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12
)
SELECT 
    '2024' AS Annee_Filtre,
    m.M AS Mois, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.Num_Commande) AS Nb_Commandes_Uniques
FROM Mois m
LEFT JOIN FACT_Commande_Client v 
    ON MONTH(v.Date_Commande) = m.M 
    AND YEAR(v.Date_Commande) = 2024
GROUP BY m.M
ORDER BY m.M;

details.question: Quel est le total impayé et le total recouvré en 2024 ?

details.question: Quel est le rendement moyen de production en 2024 ?
Quelle est la quantité totale terminée et rejetée en 2024 ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    2024 AS Annee_Filtre, 
    (SELECT SUM(Qte_Terminee) 
     FROM FACT_PROD_Consommation 
     WHERE YEAR(Date_Cloture) = 2024) AS Quantite_Totale_Terminee, 
    (SELECT SUM(Qte_Rejetee) 
     FROM FACT_PROD_Declaration 
     WHERE YEAR(Date_Echeance) = 2024) AS Quantite_Totale_Rejetee;

details.question: Quel est le rendement moyen de production par mois en 2024 ? (vue RH)
Quel est le total des impayés et des recouvrements par mois en 2024 ? (vue RH)
details.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    2024 AS Annee_Filtre, 
    Mois, 
    SUM(Total_Impaye) AS Somme_Total_Impaye, 
    SUM(Total_Recouvrement) AS Somme_Total_Recouvrement
FROM AGG_Recouvrement_Client
WHERE Annee = 2024
GROUP BY Mois
ORDER BY Mois;

details.question: Quels sont les 5 clients avec le plus gros chiffre d'affaires en 2024 ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT TOP 5
    c.Nom_Client,
    v.Code_Client,
    '2024' AS Annee_Filtre,
    SUM(v.CA_TND) AS CA_TND_Total,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.CA_TND) DESC) AS Rang
FROM FACT_Vente v
JOIN DIM_Client c ON v.Code_Client = c.Code_Client
WHERE YEAR(v.Date_Facture) = 2024
GROUP BY c.Nom_Client, v.Code_Client
ORDER BY CA_TND_Total DESC;

details.question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires par pays en 2024 ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    r.Pays, 
    2024 AS Annee_Filtre, 
    SUM(v.CA_TND) AS Total_CA_TND
FROM FACT_Vente v
JOIN DIM_Region r ON v.Code_Region = r.Code_Region
WHERE YEAR(v.Date_Facture) = 2024
GROUP BY r.Pays;

details.question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires par famille d'article en 2024 ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    DIM_Article.Famille_Article, 
    SUM(FACT_Vente.CA_TND) AS CA_Total, 
    2024 AS Annee_Filtre
FROM FACT_Vente
JOIN DIM_Article ON FACT_Vente.Code_Article = DIM_Article.Code_Article
WHERE YEAR(FACT_Vente.Date_Facture) = 2024
GROUP BY DIM_Article.Famille_Article;

details.question: Quels sont les 5 articles les plus vendus en quantité en 2024 ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT TOP 5
    Code_Article,
    SUM(Quantité) AS Somme_Quantite,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(Quantité) DESC) AS Rang,
    2024 AS Annee_Filtre
FROM FACT_Vente
WHERE YEAR(Date_Facture) = 2024
GROUP BY Code_Article
ORDER BY Somme_Quantite DESC;

details.question: Combien de clients avons-nous par type de client ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT
    t.Description,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.Code_Client) AS Nb_Clients
FROM DIM_Type_Client t
JOIN DIM_Client c ON t.Code_Type_Client = c.Code_Type_Client
GROUP BY t.Description;

details.question: Quels sont les 5 clients avec le plus gros montant de commandes en 2024 ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT TOP 5
    '2024' AS Annee_Filtre,
    Code_Client,
    SUM(Montant_Commande) AS Total_Montant_Commande,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(Montant_Commande) DESC) AS Rang
FROM AGG_Commande

ORDER BY Total_Montant_Commande DESC;
